revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the finance partner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. Staffing has added a second pairing rule from the project office. Workers II and V are each still acceptable individually, but using both on the same four-task job now opens a one-time handling desk costing 5 cost units; the earlier Workers III-and-V handoff charge still applies exactly as before. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
